current_evidence: This is the 'validation checklist (PDF, 276 kB)' that the council's planning-applications page links to. Searches of middlesbrough.gov.uk found no newer local list, local information requirements or validation document. The PDF text carries no adoption, publication or version date.

issues.detail: WebFetch got a client error on the www.middlesbrough.gov.uk URL and on the www planning page. The same file loads at the non-www host (middlesbrough.gov.uk/media/nbafjkb1/...). The link probably works in a browser, but automated checks against the www host fail.
issues.evidence: WebFetch of www URL: 'failed at its site (client_error)'; non-www URL returned 'Middlesbrough Council – Planning Application Validation Checklist'.

issues.detail: The List date 2016-06-01 comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate), but the document text has no adoption, publication or update date. The list should be recorded as undated. Its content is clearly old: it cites the 1995 GPDO, and has no BNG, fire statement or other post-2016 national requirements.
issues.evidence: Document text: no date; the only year mentioned is 1995 (General Permitted Development Order).

issues.detail: All six Householder rows come from other sections of the checklist. 'Floor plans / Elevations', 'Lawful development evidence' (sworn affidavits) and 'Planning Statement' (statement of grounds for the Certificate) are from the Certificate of Lawfulness section. 'Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment', 'Noise Impact Assessment' and 'Telecommunications supplementary information' are from the Telecommunications Prior Notification section ('Visual impact assessment where relevant', 'Acoustic report where relevant'). Meanwhile, Lawful development cert and prior approval are marked '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Section 9 Certificate of Lawfulness: 'Sworn affidavits(s)... Supporting Planning Statement (to include statement of grounds on which the Certificate is sought)'; Section 8 Prior Notification Procedure (Telecommunications): 'Visual impact assessment where relevant', 'Acoustic report where relevant'.

issues.detail: The real Householder requirements are not captured. Required plans: site layout at 1:100 showing neighbouring buildings and windows, elevations at 1:50, floor plans at 1:100 and sections at 1:100. May be required: Design Statement with materials (only if the site is in a conservation area), Supporting Planning Statement, details of new or altered access to a public highway or right of way, existing and proposed car parking, Drainage Strategy/Flood Risk Assessment, and Tree Survey.
issues.evidence: Section 1 Householder Applications: Design Statement 'only if the site is within a conservation area'.

issues.detail: The Full planning 'may be required' list is almost entirely missing; Grokbot has only DAS and Heritage Statement, taken from web page text. The missing items are: Transport Assessment, Draft Travel Plan, Environmental Statement, Sustainability Appraisal, Retail Assessment, Regeneration Assessment, Air Quality Assessment, Noise Impact Assessment, Sound Insulation Assessment, Energy Statement, Utilities Statement, Nature Conservation/Ecological Assessment, Historical & Archaeological Assessment, Listed Building/Conservation Area appraisal, Flood Impact Assessment, Affordable Housing Statement, ventilation/extraction details, refuse disposal details, Structural Survey, Tree Survey, Lighting Assessment, Sunlight/Daylight Assessment and Planning Obligations/Draft Heads of Terms. Also missing are the required plans: elevations at 1:100, floor plans at 1:50, and two 1:200 site survey plans of existing and proposed features. The source gives no fixed triggers for these and tells applicants to contact the planning department.
issues.evidence: Section 2 Full Planning Application, 'may be required' list.

issues.detail: Listed building consent and Demolition in conservation area are marked '(none)', but Section 4 (Listed Building and Conservation Area Consent) has requirements. Required: elevations at 1:100 where alterations are proposed, block plan at 1:500, building plans at 1:100 for each floor with works, sections through the building, and 1:20 detail plans for new doors, windows, shopfronts, panelling, fireplaces, plaster mouldings and decorative details. May be required: Structural Survey, Supporting Planning Statement with justification, Heritage Statement, Design Statement listing all materials, and up-to-date photographs.
issues.evidence: Section 4: 'Detailed plans (1:20) for new doors, windows, shop-fronts, panelling, fireplaces, plaster mouldings and decorative details'.

issues.detail: Outline is marked '(none)', but Section 3 requires a maximum envelope plan of the proposed buildings, and lists as may be required: Environmental Statement, Planning Statement, DAS, Transport Assessment, Flood Impact Assessment, Utilities Statement, Tree Survey, Heads of Terms, Regeneration Assessment, Sustainability Assessment and Energy Statement. The change-of-use sections are also missed: Section 5 (no external works) requires a 1:500 block plan and floor plans at 1:100, and Section 6 (with external works such as a flue or new windows) requires elevations and floor plans at 1:50.
issues.evidence: Section 3 Outline: 'a maximum envelope of the proposed buildings'; Sections 5 and 6 Change of Use.

issues.detail: Works to trees is marked '(none)', but Section 7 lists a dimensioned plan with each tree numbered, a tree survey with species and details of the works, a supporting statement of reasons, and photographs. The telecom prior notification items are not captured under any prior approval or telecom row: ICNIRP declaration, area of search, mast register check, school/college and aerodrome consultation where relevant, and technical justification.
issues.evidence: Section 7 Tree Applications; Section 8 Prior Notification Procedure (Telecommunications).

issues.detail: The DAS and Heritage Statement triggers are web page sentences with no trigger in them ('Our guidance will explain whether a DAS or Heritage Statement is required'), placed under Full planning as INFERRED. The checklist ties a Design Statement to conservation-area householder sites and lists a Heritage Statement under Listed Building/Conservation Area Consent.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'Our guidance will explain whether a Design and Access Statement or Heritage Statement (PDF, 790 kB) are required'.

issues.detail: Both tab_items are navigation text from the planning web page, not requirements: one tells the user the checklist PDF exists, the other points to DAS/Heritage guidance.
issues.evidence: 'The validation checklist (PDF, 276 kB) will help you to ensure you have everything you need before you submit your planning application.'

summary: Grokbot's link is to Middlesbrough's only published validation checklist, but the document is undated (the 2016 date is PDF metadata) and clearly old. Extraction largely failed: Householder rows were filled with Certificate of Lawfulness and telecom items, and the real Householder, Full, Outline, LBC/CAC, change of use and tree requirements in the checklist were not captured.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
